questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Real-time collaboration with CRDTs is error-prone under concurrency and offline conditions. This question probes end-to-end flow, test isolation, latency simulation, and reconciliation guarantees.

## Key Concepts
- CRDT-based collaboration and eventual consistency
- Offline-first edits and reconnection recovery
- Client presence, selection, and cursors
- Test data isolation with per-test doc IDs
- Network partition and latency injection

## Code Example

```javascript
const Y = require('yjs');
const { WebSocketProvider } = require('y-websocket');
// setup and assertions would go here
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you adapt tests to non-deterministic merges?
- How would you scale to 10+ clients while keeping tests reliable?
